svg.aria-label: A RestoreProof drill: the backup restores and the app boots, but 55 invoice files are missing, so the verdict is PARTIAL.

text.tspan: billing-portal · recovery point nightly-2026-11-06 · run rp-20261107-095753-f1aa
database artifact is present and intact
uploads artifact is present and intact
uploads archive is safe to extract
container images are present and pinned by digest
isolated network created (internal, no internet egress)
2 tables, 1,290 rows restored into a fresh PostgreSQL
1,149 files (713,758 bytes) extracted to isolated scratch storage
every invoice belongs to a customer
every invoice PDF referenced in the database exists
55 of 1,204 files the database points to are missing from the
backup; all of them under invoices/2026/10/
a customer opens invoice INV-2152 and downloads the PDF
got HTTP 404, expected status 200; content-type application/pdf
4 temporary resources removed, restored data deleted
The app boots, but the business does not fully come back: 55 of 1,204 files
its database points to are gone.
